## Summary

Describe the user problem and the focused change. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their actual results. Explain anything not tested.

## Risks and compatibility

Describe data-loss risks, IPC/plugin changes, migrations or breaking behavior.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, include before/after screenshots using sample files only.

## Checklist

- [ ] The title and commit messages follow the English Conventional Commit policy.
- [ ] Tests or documentation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private user data, personal paths or generated installers are included.
- [ ] File-operation tests use disposable fixtures.
- [ ] Applicable type, unit, end-to-end and packaging checks are recorded above.
